author: Inside Edition
description: An old game is getting a new production, just in time for the holidays. The Rubik’s Cube is being manufactured in Hungary, its country of origin. While many Cubes are made abroad, a new robot-run production company will make a million of them every year. The inventor of the iconic puzzle says he’s thrilled to bring his creation home. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Rubik’s Cube Inventor Is Thrilled With New Development

author: Inside Edition
description: Kissimmee Police in Florida released a photo of a child in an apartment where they were called for a domestic disturbance. Cops say after repeated knocks on the door went unanswered, they deployed a drone to try to see inside the residence. The drone captured an image of a child holding a sign that said ‘Help Us.’ Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Child Holds ‘Help Us’ Sign In Window During Domestic Disturbance: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: Getting a seat in Oprah’s audience the day she brought out her Favorite Things meant you were going home with thousands of dollars worth of new merch. It’s been 30 years since Oprah started her holiday tradition. Since her her show has been off the air, she hasn’t revealed her items of choice in front of an audience. This year is different, though. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Oprah Gives An Audience Her Favorite Things For 1st Time in 15 Years

author: Inside Edition
description: The family of the infant who was found buried alive in South Carolina is speaking out. The baby’s grandfather says it is a miracle his grandson survived, and the child’s great-aunt said there is no excuse for what the baby’s father is accused of doing. Little Koah was found in a dog crate buried in the ground near his grandfather’s home, cops say. The child’s father, Michael Comer, is charged with attempted murder, unlawful conduct toward a child, custodial interference, and burglary.
title: Family Of Baby Buried Alive In Dog Crate Speaks Out
